notes.title: Time to RAMPAGE!
notes.content:
[h3]YO! We got a new game mode for you apes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/bea3bfda32e985c3406b7a4965bfb0db55fe2aa0.png[/img]
[/h3]
This game mode is intense [b]non-stop action[/b], with [b]on-the-fly upgrades[/b].
It's gonna challenge your [b]skills [/b]and your physical [b]endurance[/b].

[i][b]Your goal:[/b][/i] smash as many tons of metal as you can before the bots (or a heart attack) take you out.

You'll earn[b] Bronze, Silver,[/b] and [b]Gold [/b]medals as you progress and upgrade your mech - but [b]combat challenges[/b] will start piling up as well, making the enemy bots stronger and stronger.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/054780d7699d151ad426dc9502338c95dcc5370f.png[/img]
Every week a new [b]Weekly Set[/b] (aka seed) of bots and upgrades will be generated, with its own leaderboard to compete over. You can also just play a [b]Random Set[/b] to mix things up whenver you want.

We're stoked about RAMPAGE and hope it will scratch the itch for all you adrenaline junkies, fitness buffs and optimizers out there.
 
...


...But you know us by now, we couldn't help ourselves and also added a bunch of other things to this update. For example:

There's now a [b]NEW RUN menu[/b] allowing you to [b]choose your starting weapons:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/7b83cef6d26f2364293a81f03dda007068d773c9.png[/img]

We also made [b]bashing a lot more fun and effective[/b], made [b]a [i]ton [/i]of item changes[/b], and more. 
You can read about all [b][url=https://production.d18ywllgagsugm.amplifyapp.com/announcement/712398]in the news feed here[/url].[/b]


GL HF
- One Hamsa

notes.title: VR Camera Toolbox
notes.content:
Sup all!

While we're at work on bigger upcoming updates, we decided to polish and roll out a tool we made for internal use: [b]the VR Camera Toolbox.[/b]

[previewyoutube=9k-7B_QpjBM;full][/previewyoutube]

The Camera Toolbox lets you setup cameras and capture the game, all from inside VR*.
Toggle it on during combat from the Settings menu and it'll appear in your cockpit.

Some of its features:
[list]
[*] Record landscape or portrait
[*] Use a selfie cam, third person cam, stationary cam, and more
[*] Slow down time (Sandbox only)
[*] Preview last recording
[*] Hide bubble from recording camera
[*] Automatically pause the game when adjusting cameras
[/list]

While we were at it:
[list]
[*] We added a toggle in the settings that turns off the OG bling. This is a temporary solution, but for those who've been waiting - take your bling now, it won't stay there for long!
[*] Fixed recentering button in settings and after calibration for Steam users
[/list]

GL HF
- One Hamsa

* Fair warning - the Camera Toolbox has some performance costs and might be felt in extreme combat situations or on weaker machines.

notes.title: the COMBAT BOOST update
notes.content:
Sup everyone!
We're glad to introduce the Xmas update you didn't know you needed!
Strap up, there's a lot of new shit:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/f42dade416f06e18cc743e5e3a7c42e7cc029bd9.png[/img]
We found a new supplier of Bombots and now have 3 new Bombots types in the game; [b]Red, yellow and blue.[/b] Each of the new bombots explosions deal a different status effect; [b]Overheat, Shock and Turbo.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/09bc5475ab954c5694a40465935a0f0acb55e87c.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/0f816e853b205cb860f0e89380fa1bd53d75c795.png[/img]
Ripping enemies is now [b]more fun and more effective[/b], making [b]double grabber builds viable.[/b]
Just yank them hard to deal a shitton of damage - [b]the harder you yank, the deader they get.
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/c740aa1d3c13732b0e2ec6370e79227d6db16665.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/6e153adc0dfd4696e7fcb9f8844e876f444cd01f.png[/img]
We rewrote how the level algorithm selects and spawns enemies.
Levels are now more [b]procedurally generated[/b], making [b]combat feel fresh and ensuring variety every run.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/99c985f4a85084bf56e1be45f25004b0d0b5c75c.png[/img]
To celebrate Xmas and the first coming of Shanta, [b]we've bestowed Jingle Balls (AKA Festicles) upon all the enemies[/b] in the game (except Pricella, because... well...).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/bb6ec310b5f6f23e6d62b09baad6193e8fe73db5.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/6816efc19f513544f1e68c2118065fd06673c687.png[/img]
Alphadogs are now [b]more fun to play against.[/b]
Their attacks [b]more predictable[/b] - they lock in on a target and charge at it from a distance, with little ability to change course.

They [b]can also be countered while attacking.[/b]
Alphas no longer go Turbo while attacking, and don't intercept anything around - so if you evade well enough you can smack'em upside the head.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/0bfe0f999c79825cbac0f8cefcba07b416d8f694.gif[/img]

Overall, Alphas are no longer a "stop everything and run" enemy - they're now more of a "focus and time your attack" enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/f229de654abecdb8981c608ccf350921fc5aded3.png[/img]
We changed repairs so you're never stuck without them, but find yourself closer to death more frequently.

[h2]On top of all of these[/h2]
we have a ton of small improvements to the game, balance tweaks and bug fixes.
[url=https://production.d18ywllgagsugm.amplifyapp.com/announcement/431596]Check out the full changelog here[/url] or in the ingame News Feed.

Hope you all have a good holiday season <3

GL HF
- One Hamsa

notes.title: BUZZSAW!
notes.content:
[h3]Since the dawn of time, man has looked at the world and dreamed of [b]SAWING THE FUCK OUT OF SHIT[/b].

And now, our dear brattas and sistas, that dream is our reality 🙏😑 [/h3]

[h1]Introducing: [spoiler][b]THE BUZZSAW[/b]! (Duh...)[/spoiler][/h1]
[previewyoutube=CMqe390my_8;full][/previewyoutube]
The Buzzsaw has been a [i]long  [/i]time coming - not only does it appear in our cover art, but it is also one of the first weapons ever prototyped in UNDERDOGS, and the second most requested feature.
We're excited with how it came out and glad to make good on our promise!

[b]This update includes quite a bit of other changes, here are the main ones:[/b]
[list]
[*] [h3]THE BUZZSAW[/h3][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/86264d5246fa9a53bc027a18e8e647cac944af57.gif[/img]
The Buzzsaw and its three unique addons are now available from ACT I. They appear in shops and hails, but particularly Apache's patron rewards changed to Advanced Tech (such as the Buzzsaw), and Nait now has more  chance of having the Buzzsaw addons.
[b]You can try out the buzzsaw immediately from the main menu!
[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]News runs now start with a random unlocked weapon![/b] This can be toggled off by checking the Vanilla Rilla checkbox in the Hangar.
[*] [b]Ussam got a major behavior boost.[/b] He's now more dangerous and requires higher skill to finish off.
[*] [b]Jacks' got some love[/b] - their physics respond better, their arms are easier to destroy, and we've added a mini-jack at the end of Day 4 as preparation for the new Ussam.
[*] NPC and Item unlocks relaxed - more items and NPCs are available from the beginning of the career, and number of possbile item unlocks per run increased.
[*] Added[b] RUSSIAN![/b]
[*] Added Auto-Skip Seen Cutscenes option to the Settings.
[*] Sandboxxer Challenges unlock conditions relaxed.
[*] Fixed adult filter on king’s voice lines in Quest 2
[/list]

There's a bunch more changes and fixes in this update, all listed in [url=https://production.d18ywllgagsugm.amplifyapp.com/announcement/765356]the game's News Feed[/url].

GO SAW OFF SOME FACES!

 GL HF
- 1/5

notes.title: SANDBOXXER IS HERE!
notes.content:
Brattas and sistas, it's here.
[h3]Sandboxxer is a brand new game mode featuring tons of UNDERDOGS mini-games, and the tools to create and share your own.[/h3]

Wanna make 4 Ussams fight each other? [b]You got it.[/b]
Wanna drop in for a ten minute fitness challenge? [b]You got it.[/b]
Wanna try an insane build and fight 10 turbo Junkdogs with 500 HP? [b]You got it![/b]
Wanna make a crazy-ass level and watch everyone compete over the high-scores? [b]You got it!!![/b]

Ok ok. You get it.
This update opens everything in UNDERDOGS for you guys to play with, and unlocks a huge amount of new content.


Main features:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/ad6dcc9f5347dc049a31c66e0429155d3d3d8317.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/ec563a22240a21e7ba42ba12a91b444c8b9c1c99.gif[/img]
Our own hand-crafted mini-games, unlockable through the campaign, featuring completion levels and leaderboards.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/13562af2cbb7a7ff27efd6517dc2d9f550e821e2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/e9ce2f36f57ede899ac152640739192b026f7ff7.gif[/img]
A massive tool that lets you create anything; from throwing in a 50 exploding barrels for the lolz, to creating elaborate mini-games with your own rules.
This is the exact same tool we used to make the Challenges.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/3ba989a7903982230791572d9c4f0eb06f3c7644.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/f35c94d37374c55d4669e16b7ccac6efefeb3166.gif[/img]
Share your level with everyone, and browse, play, rate and compete over and endless variety of levels created by our... ahum... not at all unhinged community...



More features:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/cb7bde2cc255d12c25eb066b6a4418f6523c35b5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/de532f57ff2566cd299b71f107fc4013d7d0cd53.png[/img]
Our first batch of Steam achievements, connected to the Challenges. F*ckin finally!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/16ff4dc91c9e9e0c74ddc621e19b2569c976e5da.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/0ef0c20debaf03ca92ccdb07075cbd65fa4adc93.gif[/img]
A new practice room to train in, try our different builds, enemy combinations and props.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/7773471a3c27acac94109dcb2c9b3fe278fd1265.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/9fc48685270cdcdff58f34a445dbd690b3181b08.gif[/img]
You can now finally play the Skirmish with any equipment you've unlocked!
Have fun, boys and girls.


We can't wait to see what you crazy madafakas do with the Sandboxxer update!

GL HF
- 1/5

notes.title: DANGEROUS STREETS UPDATE
notes.content:
Sup all!
Work on the Sandboxxer update continues in full, and in the meantime we've got a little surprise update for you: [b]Dangerous Streets[/b].

What's in it?

[h2]New Hails![/h2]
We made [b]4 new hail events for ACT II[/b], introducing new characters such as Lashiffa and Ponette:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/8d24df6af4b427cb7aff31cab1880d7415a7b3a9.gif[/img]

And adding new tale mechanics such as Raid:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/a8a31bc68abc4269e8e340ca61910a64b6345f7a.png[/img]
Next time you play ACT II you'll have a higher chance of getting these events, [b]so go looking for some trouble![/b]

[h2]New Passive Items![/h2]
We've added [b]4 new passive items that affect street fights and stealing[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/fc4c0f6fbcf9fe99cd034d0110b783f33a6af9cc.png[/img]
These items are available in ACT I and ACT II, in some specific hails and shops. [b]Get them to find out what they do.[/b]

[h2]Busted![/h2]
Tried stealing? Got caught and burnt? [b]All shop owners now have a new illustration when they catch you stealing[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197243/8b90092266ff2cf48236e3c04156d09279cbe4d8.png[/img]
Ever wonder what Zikitta has under her desk? [b]Try stealing from her and find out![/b]

[h2]Audio Upgrade![/h2]
We've [b]updated our audio spatializer plugin[/b] and re-adjusted our SFX spatial settings - everything should sound that much better now!
We also [b]improved the ambient SFX in between fights[/b] - the background sound of The Jungle's streets is more gritty and real than ever.

[h2]More Shit?![/h2]
You veterans can now skip any cutscene, including boss intros, by long-pressing the trigger.
We've also slightly upped the chance of getting Weapons in shops, hails and Patron rewards.

That's it for now, more stuff is cooking,

GL HF
- 1/5

notes.title: Update 1.0.4 - Wrecking ball!

The Wrecking Ball is a high-skill blunt weapon that, when used well, can cause tons of DMG and provide for great crowd control.

[h3][b][url=https://production.d18ywllgagsugm.amplifyapp.com/announcement/35748]Check out the full release notes, including some more details about the wrecking ball.[/url][/b][/h3]

notes.title: Release Notes - v1.0.1
notes.content:
[b]FUN[/b]
[olist]
[*] Physics on PC build now run at double the frame rate (40hz to 80hz). Enjoy the increased accuracy!
[*] Jungledogs heads now have updated model
[/olist]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[olist]
[*] Overheat status can carry between fights, causing PWR 0% to show in garage
[*] Corruption in save files can happen when starting a new run from Hangar
[*] Roach breakdance and glitch all over the arena
[*] Minor bugfixes to encounters
[/olist]

[b]BALANCING[/b]
[olist]
[*] Repair Kits heal less
[*] Tweaks to REPAIR encounters balance
[*] Difficulty level tweaks for first runs in career
[/olist]
